notes.title: Demo update.
notes.notes:
[h1]List of changes:[/h1]

[i]- Fixed crossbowman's hitbox.
- Fixed bugs that could cause crashes.
- Fixed hit while rolling.
- The crossbowman's reload animation has become slower.
- The shaking when hitting from a place is weaker than on the enemy.
- Training by rolling (it was, but now it's more understandable).
- Correction of the sound of coughing on one of the levels.
- Ability to skip "Hey! Anyone else..."
- Fixed Leon's hitbox.
- The jump has become a little higher.
- Ability to jump onto the platform without any difficulty.
- New secret.[/i]

[u][b]-DEADMAP[/b][/u]
